definitions.explanation: A road or street with rows of trees planted along one or both sides. A common feature of parks, boulevards, and scenic routes in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{並木道|なみきみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked along a cherry tree-lined road.
In autumn, the leaves on the tree-lined road turn red.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{並木道|なみきみち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百年以上|ひゃくねんいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{愛|あい}されている→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: This tree-lined avenue has over a hundred years of history and is loved by the citizens.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧ (row of trees) and ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road). Used to describe scenic streets, especially those famous for seasonal beauty like cherry blossoms in spring or colorful leaves in autumn. ⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧ alone can also refer to a row of trees along a street.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{並木道|なみきみち} (cherry tree-lined road)
- ⟦{銀杏|いちょう}→銀杏：04379_ichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{並木道|なみきみち} (ginkgo tree-lined avenue)
- {並木道|なみきみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk along a tree-lined road)
- {並木道|なみきみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧ (to stroll along a tree-lined road)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧: row of trees — the trees themselves, not necessarily the road
- ⟦{街路樹|がいろじゅ}→街路樹：15414_gairoju⟧: roadside trees — individual trees planted along streets
